distribution.notes: Stable v1 CLI package name is not directly confirmed in docs/research/T03-opencode.md (only @opencode-ai/sdk, @opencode-ai/plugin and the v2-beta @opencode-ai/cli@beta are source-confirmed). Confirm the exact v1 package at deployment time; both candidates are probed. Do not add a third guess without new evidence.
distribution.windowsNativeSupportEvidence: opencode.ai/docs/windows-wsl/ strongly recommends WSL over native Windows for opencode serve; native Windows is reported to run with degraded filesystem/terminal/tool compatibility. No first-party Windows .exe build is documented. See docs/engines/opencode.md.

acp.subcommandEvidence: opencode.ai/docs/acp/ documents `opencode acp` as a stdio JSON-RPC ACP agent (cross-checked in docs/research/T03-opencode.md #10 and #45 of DIGEST.md).

node.fallbackNotes: When unresolved, falls back to process.execPath (the gateway's own node.exe), since PNP itself runs on Node >=24 on Windows. Override via configuredPath/environmentVariable if opencode requires a different Node major version.

executable.windowsShimNotes: npm's global install on Windows produces opencode.cmd, a batch shim invoking node.exe plus the real .js entry. The shared ProcessHost spawns with shell:false and rejects any executable that is not an absolute path ending in .exe (see src/runtime/process-host.ts validation), so opencode.cmd can never be used directly. node-script mode resolves node.exe and the real script path so the host launches node.exe <script> acp instead of the shim.

redirect.notes: Every key here is set on the child process only, rooted under EngineOpenInput.nativeDataDirectory/opencode/<value>. The shared ProcessHost's baseEnvironment() otherwise inherits the gateway's real HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA, which would point opencode at the operator's real profile; these overrides are what prevents that. docs/research/T03-opencode.md only confirms POSIX-style paths (~/.config, ~/.local/share, ~/.cache) for opencode's config/data/cache; its Windows path resolution (os.homedir()+'.config' vs an env-paths style APPDATA convention vs honoring XDG_*) is not verified, so the private opencode.json and skills are mirrored under both the HOME/.config and XDG_CONFIG_HOME hypotheses (see docs/engines/opencode.md).

model.rationale: ACP session/set_config_option with a model-category SessionConfigOption is a generic ACP v1 feature (docs/research/T12-acp-agent-client-protocol.md #57), but no research source confirms opencode acp advertises it at runtime; the only opencode-acp-specific note found is issue #18672 (update ordering), which does not mention config options. Pinning the model at launch via the private opencode.json's top-level `model` field (provider/model syntax, source-confirmed in T03) fails closed instead of assuming an unverified session-config surface: an unsupported model raises ENGINE_MODEL_SWITCH_UNSUPPORTED on the first prompt rather than every prompt. Revisit once a real opencode acp session's NewSessionResponse.configOptions has been observed.
